mechanics.claim: Rage is generated over 2 seconds (4 ticks every 0.5s) upon dealing or receiving damage, refreshing rather than stacking with subsequent triggers.
mechanics.quote: The ''Rage'' generated upon dealing or receiving damage occurs over 2 seconds with 4 ticks every {{fd|0.5}} seconds. It also does not stack but instead refreshes with subsequent applications

mechanics.claim: Against champions, Boulder Toss/Boomerang Throw generates Rage once per cast based on the first enemy hit, and on-hit basic attacks instantly generate Rage as well.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' can only generate ''Rage'' once per cast, and grants ''Rage'' based on the first enemy hit.

mechanics.claim: Casting an ability while at max Rage causes an instant transformation into Mega Gnar instead of waiting for the 4 second window to elapse.
mechanics.quote: Casting any of them during this time also causes '''Gnar''' to transform into {{ci|Mega Gnar}} instantly

mechanics.claim: Gnar's abilities share cooldowns across Mini and Mega forms.
Mega Gnar's bonus health is not affected by healing modifiers such as Grievous Wounds or healing items/runes.
mechanics.quote: {{cis|Mega Gnar}} gained health is not affected by {{tip|healing}} modifiers such as {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} and those from [[item]]s and [[rune]]s.

mechanics.claim: When reverting to Mini Gnar, Gnar retains his current health percentage rather than his current total health.
mechanics.quote: When returning to {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}}, '''Gnar''' will only retain his current health percentage, not current health total.
